description: Golden set for po-intake extraction. Each case points at a seeded PO PDF and its ground-truth extraction JSON (generated from the exact pdf-lib draw positions at seed time — the strongest possible labels). The scorer compares value fields, including expected nulls (tax_cents, notes, line2…) — an invented value for an absent fact counts as a fabrication error, which is the point.

cases.note: Clean stock order — extraction should validate straight through the layers.
References quote Q-1042 with a price mismatch — extraction must transcribe the printed (wrong) numbers verbatim, not correct them.
